## Data for Questions 1 to 3

The following are the daily commuting times (in minutes) reported by 24 students.

```r
commute <- c(18, 25, 32, 41, 27, 35, 22, 19, 45, 38, 29, 24,
             31, 36, 40, 26, 33, 28, 21, 44, 30, 37, 23, 39)
```

---

## Question 1

:::{.callout-warning}
## Grouped Frequency Distribution

Construct a grouped frequency distribution for `commute` using **5 classes**.

1. Find the range with `max()` and `min()`, then determine the class width.
2. Use `cut()` together with `table()` to obtain the frequency of each class.
3. Add the cumulative frequency with `cumsum()`.
:::

---

## Question 2

:::{.callout-warning}
## Histogram

Draw a histogram of `commute` with `ggplot()` and `geom_histogram()` using 5 bins. Give the graph a title and label both axes with `labs()`.

Describe the shape of the distribution in one sentence.
:::

---

## Question 3

:::{.callout-warning}
## Ogive

Draw the ogive (cumulative frequency graph) of `commute`.

Plot the cumulative frequency from Question 1 against the upper class boundaries with `geom_line()` and `geom_point()`.

From the graph, estimate how many students commute less than 35 minutes.
:::
